item.title: US Star Naomi Girma Sends Blues to FA Cup Quarterfinals with 1st Chelsea Goal
item.description: USWNT star Naomi Girma played hero for Chelsea FC on Sunday, scoring her 1st-ever goal with the Blues to send the WSL club to next month's 2026 FA Cup quarterfinals. The post US Star Naomi Girma Sends Blues to FA Cup Quarterfinals with 1st Chelsea Goal appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Nike’s Tennis Struggles Continue as Emma Raducanu Signs Multi-Million Dollar Uniqlo Deal
item.description: Nike lost another tennis star this week, as Emma Raducanu signed with Uniqlo to mark the brand's latest setback in the global sport. The post Nike’s Tennis Struggles Continue as Emma Raducanu Signs Multi-Million Dollar Uniqlo Deal appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Jessica Pegula Withdraws from ATX Open with Knee Injury Days After Dubai Victory
item.description: Defending champion Jessica Pegula withdrew from the 2026 ATX Open with a left knee injury, days after winning her 10th WTA title in Dubai. The post Jessica Pegula Withdraws from ATX Open with Knee Injury Days After Dubai Victory appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Venus Williams Ousted from 2026 ATX Open as Ajla Tomljanovic Completes Sister Sweep
item.description: Venus Williams lost to Ajla Tomljanovic 6-4, 6-1 in the ATX Open first round, after the tennis icon earned wild card entry to the 2026 event. The post Venus Williams Ousted from 2026 ATX Open as Ajla Tomljanovic Completes Sister Sweep appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Adidas Debuts Nordic-Inspired Official Match Ball for Women’s Champions League Final
item.description: Adidas unveiled the official Champions League match ball for the 2026 UWCL final in Oslo, featuring Nordic-inspired nods to the Tiger City. The post Adidas Debuts Nordic-Inspired Official Match Ball for Women’s Champions League Final appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Minnesota Lynx Set 2026 WNBA Preseason Game Against Nigeria
item.description: The Minnesota Lynx will make WNBA history before the 2026 season even tips off, becoming the first squad to play an African national team when they face Nigeria in a preseason friendly. The post Minnesota Lynx Set 2026 WNBA Preseason Game Against Nigeria appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Black History Month Spotlight: Dual-Sport Olympic Medalist Lauryn Williams
item.description: As the first and only US woman to medal at both the Summer and Winter games, Lauryn Williams owns Olympic hardware in both track and field and bobsledding. The post Black History Month Spotlight: Dual-Sport Olympic Medalist Lauryn Williams appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
